key_insight: Causal feature selection and a defensive variational autoencoder enable efficient, attack-resilient mmWave beam alignment while maintaining prediction accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce beam-training overhead and improve wireless-link resilience to manipulated received-power measurements.
method: Learn a Bayesian graph linking RSSI measurements to the optimal beam index.
Select a minimal set of relevant RSSI features for a deep-learning beam classifier.
Denoise potentially adversarial inputs with a defensive variational autoencoder and fine-tune the downstream classifier.
evidence_signal: Simulations report 829× lower per-sample computation than SHAP-based feature selection, 59.4% less beam-sweeping overhead than conventional DL selection, 89.8% less than exhaustive search, and 85% accuracy across tested adversarial perturbation bounds.
watch_item: Simulation results do not establish robustness to real-world channel shifts or attacks outside the evaluated scenarios.
paper_title: Causal AI-Driven Secure mmWave Beam Alignment with Defensive Variational Autoencoders
